title: acisanthera limnobios
intro: Acisanthera limnobios, commonly known as the "yellow water lily", is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. The health benefits of Acisanthera limnobios include its potential to treat various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Acisanthera limnobios have been found to contain alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
